source_name: Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs (MVD) data, reported by The Moscow Times, 16 April 2021

LOWER BOUND: source states 'more than 1.2 million'; recorded here as 1,200,000. No published method statement accompanies the figure.

source_name: OECD International Migration Database (stocks of foreign-born population, measure B14)
notes: Foreign-born population, OECD IMD series sourced from TurkStat address-based registration. CAUTION - CORRECTED NOTE: an earlier note asserted this series includes Syrians under temporary protection. Comparison against UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2024 contradicts that: UN DESA reports 6,580,295 for Turkey in 2020 against 2,609,982 here, and the ~4.0 million gap is close to the number of Syrians under temporary protection at that date. The treatment of Syrians is therefore unresolved and Turkey should be verified against TurkStat directly before use. Turkey's foreign_nationals series definitely excludes them.
